description: This file implements a CredentialedUnixServer class that manages a UNIX domain socket server with credential passing capabilities, including methods to open, accept clients, and retrieve the socket file descriptor.

classes.name: CredentialedUnixServer
classes.description: A class that encapsulates a UNIX domain socket server with credential passing enabled, providing methods to open the server, accept clients, and access the socket file descriptor.

methods.name: CredentialedUnixServer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the server with a file descriptor.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Static method to create and initialize a CredentialedUnixServer instance bound to a specified socket path.

methods.name: AcceptClient
methods.description: Accepts an incoming client connection and returns a file descriptor wrapped in FDCloser.

methods.name: Fd
methods.description: Returns the underlying socket file descriptor.
